title: Background image example
_note: The six templates that take a background image. background.src is a path relative to this file (or an https URL); background.tint (0 to 1) is how strongly the brand background colour covers the image so the text stays readable. On the photo cover the image is the cover photo itself and the tint is not used: the cover has its own fade.
